title: "Cannot locate rosdep definition for" in ROS 2 rosdep install: --ignore-src, ROS_DISTRO, wrong keys, pip keys and custom sources, measured
excerpt: What causes rosdep's Cannot locate rosdep definition error: a workspace package without --ignore-src, ROS_DISTRO unset, python-numpy instead of python3-numpy, or a custom key with no source. Also why -r exits 0, rosdep init twice, and pip keys under PEP 668. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
